explanations.22: This helper function checks whether we're viewing a single blog post or a list of posts, and returns a CSS class name only for list view to add spacing.
explanations.24: The question mark returns one value if the condition is true, otherwise the colon returns the other value—this is called a ternary operator.
explanations.31: This creates an AI icon component only if the post's metadata says it was AI-assisted AND we're on the full post page (not a preview card).
explanations.52: This checks if the frontMatter explicitly says tried_it is false; if it's anything else (true or missing), the TriedIt component will render.
